items.source: Compare this condition to another in the context of a specific message. It is assumed both instances have been obtained via MessageCondition.getMatchingCondition(Message) to ensure they have content relevant to current message only.
items.translation: 将此条件与另一个在特定消息的上下文中进行比较。假设这两个实例均通过 MessageCondition.getMatchingCondition(Message) 获取，以确保它们仅包含与当前消息相关的内容。

items.source:
Check if this condition matches the given Message and returns a
potentially new condition with content tailored to the current message.
items.translation: 检查此条件是否与给定的 Message 匹配，并返回一个针对当前消息量身定制内容的潜在新条件。

items.source: The notation to use when printing discrete items of content.
items.translation: 打印离散内容项时应使用的符号。

items.source:
The notation to use when printing discrete items of content.
For example " || " for URL patterns or " && " for param expressions.
items.translation: 用于打印离散内容项的符号。例如，URL 模式使用" || "或参数表达式使用" && "。

items.source:
Define the rules for combining this condition with another.
For example combining type- and method-level conditions.
items.translation: 定义将此条件与另一个条件组合的规则。例如，组合类型级和方法级条件。

items.source:
Check if this condition matches the given Message and returns a
potentially new condition with content tailored to the current message.
For example a condition with destination patterns might return a new
condition with sorted, matching patterns only.
items.translation: 检查此条件是否与给定的 Message 匹配，并返回一个可能包含针对当前消息定制内容的条件。例如，具有目标模式的条件的可能会返回一个新条件，其中仅包含已排序的匹配模式。

items.source: other - the condition to combine with
items.translation: other - 用于组合的条件

items.source: a condition instance in case of a match; or null if there is no match.
items.translation: 匹配时返回条件实例；若无匹配，则返回null。
